title: Service event envelope
description: The outer object of every service event. Identical to the WebhookEnvelope Vireek POSTs today (supabase/functions/api-v1/contract.ts). `data` is validated by the schema named in event-types.json for the given `event`.

id.description: Delivery id. Identical across automatic retries of the same delivery; consumers de-duplicate on it.

data.description: The record the event is about.
